verdict.rationale: Connecting external MCP servers is a fair question for an API client that ships AI features, so the axis applies. The pack only documents Hoppscotch's own MCP server, which exposes its collections to an outside agent host. That is the server role and does not show Hoppscotch consuming other MCP servers' tools. Its documented AI features (renaming requests, generating payloads, writing scripts and tests) say nothing about plugging in MCP servers.
